stimulus.text: Paraphrase of Dr. Benjamin Spock, The Common Sense Book of Baby and Child Care (1946). Spock told parents to trust their own judgment, writing that 'you know more than you think you do.' He called child-rearing a natural process and urged a relaxed, permissive approach instead of strict schedules and harsh discipline.

stem: Spock's advice best reflects which broader change in postwar American family life?

options.text: Parents rejected all expert advice about raising children
options.misconception: Background from the books: Spock was himself an expert, and parents bought his book by the millions, so they did not reject experts.

options.text: Parents looked to doctors and child experts to guide family life
The federal government took charge of raising children
options.misconception: Background from the books: no federal program took charge of raising children in the 1950s.

options.text: Families returned to the strict child-rearing ways of the 1800s
options.misconception: Spock urged a relaxed approach, which broke from the strict ways of the 1800s rather than returning to them.

rationales.A: Background from the books: Spock was himself an expert, and parents bought his book by the millions, so they did not reject experts.
rationales.B: Background from the books: a pediatrician's book became the guide for millions of homes, which shows experts, not only grandparents, now shaped family life.
rationales.C: Background from the books: no federal program took charge of raising children in the 1950s.
rationales.D: Spock urged a relaxed approach, which broke from the strict ways of the 1800s rather than returning to them.
rationales.general:
1. Background from the books: Spock was a pediatrician, an expert, and his book reached millions of homes.
2. Background from the books: pediatricians, child psychologists, and advice writers formed a new expert culture around family life.
3. When an expert's book guides the nursery, family life has shifted from tradition toward expert advice.
Remember: When a profession's advice book becomes a household item, that profession has gained new authority.
